info.title: lease-loop
info.description: Lease Loop hackathon starter: a walking skeleton for a circular-economy leasing app.

post.summary: Act as a customer or admin: sets the actor cookie (no login, D17)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

delete.summary: Stop acting: clears the actor cookie, so the visitor is anonymous

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Submit the answers for a quote: prunes, validates, evaluates the eligibility rules (D9); the admin only with onBehalfOf (D47); 409 QUOTE_IN_USE while another application holds the quote (D56); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: An application with its decision and reasons as codes with params (the applicant or admin; 404 for another customer, D57); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: An admin decides a manual review (D10); an awaiting_signatory case is refused (signatory_required): it is signed through the link (D46); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: The applicant (or the admin for them) withdraws an application not signed yet: approved, in manual review or awaiting the signatory (D87); 409 APPLICATION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE when signed or final; 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: List the assets in the catalogue, optionally of one category

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Assess a returned asset on the request's day and relist it: the plan, the second-life price (D86: the market value), the waiting-list match (D13), the asset available (admin); an optional body is the inspection (D77); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74), 422 relist_unpriced (no condition can be leased)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: An asset's passport: its lives across leases and the CO2 and money its later lives saved (D15, D80)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

patch.summary: Admin only: change an asset's status along D22's transitions, audited; 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: The 50 newest audit rows, newest first

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: Walk the audit hash chain: intact with its length and head hash, or the first broken row (read-only, every actor)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Sign an approved application on the request's day: copies the quote, emits CONTRACT_SIGNED (the applicant or admin); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: A contract with its frozen price and why it holds (the contract's customer or admin); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Buy out, return or pass on on the request's day: sets the status, emits the event, bills the exit (the customer or admin); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: What buying, returning or passing on would cost on the request's day, line by line (D14), without writing; 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: The company's signatory list with each entry's state today (the company or admin, D46); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Add a signatory, valid from validFrom up to validTo (the company's own signatory or admin, D46); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: End a signatory's right today; the last active one cannot be revoked (D46); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Run scenario card 1 to 10 through the real services on the card's days, set the demo clock and actor, answer the steps and the landing page (409 card_already_run links the earlier records); 404 while DEMO_TOOLS is off (D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Set the demo clock to a day, or clear it with null (the one date the browser may send)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: A contract's invoices in sequence order (the contract's customer or admin); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Pay an invoice on the request's day: audited, emits INVOICE_PAID (the contract's customer or admin); 401 not signed in, 403 FORBIDDEN (D73, D74)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: Price on today's date and store the quote, valid 14 days (D7), with its audit row

get.summary: A stored quote from its frozen numbers (never re-priced) and its status today

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: Price on today without storing: the breakdown and the term comparison (the sliders)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

get.summary: The signing link: who signs for which application, and whether it is pending (D46)

default.description: An error: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or INVALID_JSON, 404, 409, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

post.summary: The signatory signs (approved) or declines (rejected) through the link; registers them (D46)
